skill.name: set-up-shopify-chatgpt-ads-ltv-bidding
skill.description: Guide Shopify merchants through customer lifetime value bidding in ChatGPT Ads with Product Metrics. Check tracking readiness, test conversion delivery, and choose between observed lifetime revenue and profit.
skill.summary: Set up and verify Shopify lifetime value signals for ChatGPT Ads with Product Metrics.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: Most static matches describe Markdown, documented endpoints, or routine setup rather than shell substitution or reconnaissance. The optional installer can execute unpinned package code if run. The workflow also needs clearer safeguards for credentials, live data sharing, and test-order lookups, plus consistent instructions for profit LTV.

remediation.issue: The optional installer does not pin the executable package or skill revision.
remediation.suggestion: Pin an audited installer release and immutable skill revision. Keep installation manual and separate from the setup workflow.

remediation.issue: The credential exception permits the assistant to receive and forward the Conversions API key.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the chat and command exception for API keys. Direct the user to the Product Metrics credential field or a secret input that does not expose the key to the assistant.

remediation.issue: The workflow can proceed to a live conversion destination without first confirming the intended data transfer.
remediation.suggestion: Before any live write, name Product Metrics, the Shopify store, the Ads pixel, and the event data involved. Verify consent configuration and obtain merchant approval before enabling sending.

remediation.issue: Test-order lookup can inspect or report details for the wrong order.
remediation.suggestion: Ask for the merchant's test-order reference and confirm the store before retrieving it. Report only receipt, delivery status, and requested values, without customer identifiers.

remediation.issue: The main workflow names the per-order profit event for a lifetime profit setup.
remediation.suggestion: Use pm_profit_ltv for profit LTV and reserve pm_order_profit for order-profit bidding. Verify the selected event before recommending a campaign target.

semantic_findings.title: Assistant Can Receive Conversion API Credentials
semantic_findings.description: The main rules explicitly allow the assistant to ask for and pass an OpenAI Conversions API key to a command. The reference warns against pasting keys into chat, where the secret could enter conversation or tool records.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The exception and the warning explicitly conflict. The skill does not require a secret input that keeps the key out of the assistant's context.

semantic_findings.title: Live Conversion Sharing Lacks an Explicit Confirmation Gate
semantic_findings.description: The workflow can proceed from an LTV request to connection setup even when Product Metrics was not named. It does not explicitly require merchant confirmation before a live pixel starts receiving shopper event data.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The reference leaves sending on and documents shopper data fields. It describes shopper consent and a manual campaign step, but neither confirms the merchant's intended data transfer before setup writes.

semantic_findings.title: Test-Order Check May Expose Unrelated Order Data
semantic_findings.description: The workflow suggests listing orders newest first and checking details without requiring an exact test-order reference. It may inspect or report a real shopper's order instead.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documented test prompt supplies no unique reference, and the expected result includes the customer. A scoped lookup limits the store but does not distinguish test orders from live orders.

semantic_findings.title: Profit LTV Workflow Names the Wrong Event
semantic_findings.description: The main skill points to pm_order_profit, but the LTV guide specifies pm_profit_ltv for lifetime profit. Following the main instruction could direct campaign spend toward the wrong goal.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The event table distinguishes order profit from lifetime profit. The merchant makes the final selection, but the inconsistent guidance makes that selection error plausible.

content.user_title: Set Up Shopify LTV Bidding in ChatGPT Ads
content.value_statement: A first purchase can understate what a repeat customer is worth. Use Product Metrics to guide tracking setup, verify lifetime value events, and choose a revenue or profit conversion.
actual_capabilities: Check Product Metrics setup status and identify missing Shopify or ChatGPT Ads prerequisites.
Guide the merchant through Shopify app, store embed, and Ads destination setup.
Explain how customer recognition, consent, and complete order costs affect LTV event delivery.
Distinguish the revenue LTV and profit LTV conversions and explain how to select one in Ads Manager.
Guide a paid test-order check and explain missing events using the tracking status.
limitations: Live checks require access to the merchant's Product Metrics property. The merchant completes Shopify and Ads Manager steps.
LTV uses observed paid orders from recognized customers, not predicted value. Historical orders are not imported.
LTV events require marketing and analytics consent. Profit LTV requires complete costs.
ChatGPT Ads does not accept events older than seven days or revise events for later refunds.

use_cases.title: Check Store Readiness
use_cases.description: Find out whether the Shopify app, tracking, and Ads destination are ready before setting up LTV bidding.

use_cases.title: Choose a Campaign Conversion
use_cases.description: Compare revenue LTV and profit LTV, then select one conversion in Ads Manager for a pilot campaign.

use_cases.title: Investigate a Missing Profit Event
use_cases.description: Check a known test order for complete costs, customer recognition, consent, and event delivery.

prompt_templates.title: List the Requirements
prompt_templates.prompt: List what I need to use Shopify lifetime value bidding in ChatGPT Ads. Separate the Shopify, Product Metrics, and Ads Manager steps.

prompt_templates.title: Check Setup Without Changes
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: A store is already linked.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check tracking readiness for my selected Product Metrics property without making changes. Tell me which prerequisites are complete and what I must do next.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate a Missing Event
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: A paid test order was placed.
prompt_templates.prompt: Ask for my test-order reference before checking why its profit LTV event is missing. Check recognition, consent, costs, and delivery without exposing customer details.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Single-Campaign Pilot
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Tracking already delivers LTV events.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare revenue LTV and profit LTV for this property. Recommend one conversion and explain how to validate the pilot without changing campaign settings.

output_examples.input: Which conversion should I use when my costs are incomplete?
output_examples.output: Start with Revenue LTV. Profit LTV requires complete order costs, but Revenue LTV does not. Verify that a paid test order produced a revenue LTV event before selecting it in Ads Manager.

output_examples.input: Why did my paid test order not produce a profit LTV event?
output: Verify that Product Metrics received the specified paid test order.
Confirm that the order belongs to a recognized customer and has marketing and analytics consent.
Check that all order costs are known. Then confirm delivery in the OpenAI Conversions API tracking screen.

best_practices: Confirm the Shopify store, Product Metrics property, and Ads pixel before enabling event sending.
Enter your Conversions API key in the Product Metrics credential field rather than in chat.
Verify a known paid test order, then select the confirmed LTV conversion in one pilot campaign.
anti_patterns: Use per-order profit as a substitute for the profit LTV event.
Assume that a successful destination check confirms delivery of a paid order.
Reuse a purchase campaign's target ROAS without checking how the LTV event measures value.

faq.question: Do I need Product Metrics?
faq.answer: Yes. This workflow uses the Shopify app and a linked Product Metrics property to send events to your ChatGPT Ads pixel.

faq.question: What does a lifetime value event contain?
faq.answer: Each event carries the revenue or profit the paid order adds. It does not contain a forecast or repeat the customer's full value on every order.

faq.question: Which consent is required?
faq.answer: LTV events require marketing and analytics consent. Check that the consent settings match the banner your Shopify store uses.

faq.question: Why is profit LTV missing when revenue LTV is present?
faq.answer: Profit LTV requires complete order costs. Check Shopify product costs and the additional costs configured in Product Metrics.

faq.question: Are earlier orders and later refunds included?
faq.answer: Historical orders are not imported. Refunds recorded after delivery do not revise events in ChatGPT Ads.

faq.question: Who changes the campaign conversion?
faq.answer: The merchant creates and selects the LTV conversion in Ads Manager. The assistant can guide the steps and help confirm the selected event.
